### Coupons {#type-commerz-promotions-coupons-contracts-coupons}

`Commerz\Promotions\Coupons\Contracts\Coupons`

Coupons of the `coupon` promotions. A code has one form, trimmed and upper-cased, whether it is written, looked up or presented with a quote.

```php
interface Coupons {
    create(\Commerz\Promotions\Coupons\Data\CreateCoupon $command): \Commerz\Promotions\Coupons\Data\CouponView;
    // Disabling a disabled coupon changes nothing. @throws CouponNotFound
    disable(\Commerz\Promotions\Coupons\Data\DisableCoupon $command): \Commerz\Promotions\Coupons\Data\CouponView;
    // Enabling an active coupon changes nothing. @throws CouponNotFound
    enable(\Commerz\Promotions\Coupons\Data\EnableCoupon $command): \Commerz\Promotions\Coupons\Data\CouponView;
    find(\Commerz\Promotions\Coupons\Data\CouponId $id): \Commerz\Promotions\Coupons\Data\CouponView;
    // The code is normalized first. @throws CouponNotFound
    findByCode(string $code): \Commerz\Promotions\Coupons\Data\CouponView;
    // Creates exactly `count` new codes, or nothing. With an idempotency key a retry returns the batch of the first call.
    generate(\Commerz\Promotions\Coupons\Data\GenerateCoupons $command): \Commerz\Promotions\Coupons\Data\CouponBatchView;
    list(\Commerz\Promotions\Coupons\Data\ListCoupons $query): \Commerz\Pagination\Page;
    setLimit(\Commerz\Promotions\Coupons\Data\SetCouponLimit $command): \Commerz\Promotions\Coupons\Data\CouponView;
}
```

### GenerateCoupons {#type-commerz-promotions-coupons-data-generatecoupons}

`Commerz\Promotions\Coupons\Data\GenerateCoupons`

A batch of `$count` random codes of one pattern for a `coupon` promotion. In the pattern `#` stands for a character of the configured alphabet and any other character is kept (`[A-Z0-9_-]`, upper-cased): `AUTUMN-####-####`. With a key the command is idempotent: a retry returns the same batch.

```php
final readonly class GenerateCoupons {
    public readonly int $count;
    public readonly ?\Commerz\Identity\IdempotencyKey $idempotencyKey;
    public readonly string $pattern;
    public readonly \Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\PromotionId $promotion;
    public readonly ?int $usageLimit;
    __construct(\Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\PromotionId $promotion, int $count, string $pattern, ?int $usageLimit = 1, ?\Commerz\Identity\IdempotencyKey $idempotencyKey = null);
}
```

### PromotionDefinitions {#type-commerz-promotions-definitions-contracts-promotiondefinitions}

`Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Contracts\PromotionDefinitions`

Promotion definitions: the one way to write them. Every change locks the promotion row, so it waits for the orders being placed with the promotion and the counters of its limits stay exact.

```php
interface PromotionDefinitions {
    // Archiving is final; archiving an archived promotion changes nothing. @throws PromotionNotFound
    archive(\Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\ArchivePromotion $command): \Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\PromotionView;
    // Adds channels; one already assigned stays.
    assignChannels(\Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\AssignPromotionChannels $command): \Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\PromotionView;
    create(\Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\CreatePromotion $command): \Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\PromotionView;
    // Runs the quote of the input and tells, for every promotion that was switched on, whether it applied and why not. A failed quote is reported in `failure`, not thrown. Reads only; nothing is spent.
    explain(\Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\ExplainPromotions $query): \Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\PromotionExplanation;
    find(\Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\PromotionId $id): \Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\PromotionView;
    findByCode(string $code): \Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\PromotionView;
    list(\Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\ListPromotions $query): \Commerz\Pagination\Page;
    // An active promotion is paused; a paused one stays. @throws PromotionNotFound|PromotionArchived
    pause(\Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\PausePromotion $command): \Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\PromotionView;
    // A paused promotion is resumed; an active one stays. @throws PromotionNotFound|PromotionArchived
    resume(\Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\ResumePromotion $command): \Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\PromotionView;
    // Removes channels; one not assigned is ignored.
    unassignChannels(\Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\UnassignPromotionChannels $command): \Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\PromotionView;
    // An update that changes nothing writes nothing and raises no event.
    update(\Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\UpdatePromotion $command): \Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\PromotionView;
}
```

### CreatePromotion {#type-commerz-promotions-definitions-data-createpromotion}

`Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\CreatePromotion`

A promotion. The code, the stage, the activator and the currency never change afterwards. The currency is `$currency` or, when it is not given, the one of the budget and of the amounts in the rules; two different currencies are refused. A promotion with no currency has no budget and no amounts and works in every currency.

```php
final readonly class CreatePromotion {
    public readonly string $activator;
    public readonly ?\Commerz\Money\Money $budget;
    public readonly array $channels;
    public readonly string $code;
    public readonly array $conditions;
    public readonly ?\Commerz\Money\Currency $currency;
    public readonly array $effects;
    public readonly ?\DateTimeImmutable $endsAt;
    public readonly \Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\UsageLimits $limits;
    public readonly string $name;
    public readonly int $priority;
    public readonly \Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Enums\Stacking $stacking;
    public readonly \Commerz\Promotions\Rules\Enums\PromotionStage $stage;
    public readonly ?\DateTimeImmutable $startsAt;
    public readonly \Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Enums\PromotionStatus $status;
    public readonly bool $stopFurther;
    __construct(string $code, string $name, \Commerz\Promotions\Rules\Enums\PromotionStage $stage, string $activator, array $channels, array $effects, array $conditions = [], \Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Enums\Stacking $stacking = Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Enums\Stacking::Stackable, bool $stopFurther = false, int $priority = 0, ?\Commerz\Money\Currency $currency = null, \Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\UsageLimits $limits = new \Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\UsageLimits, ?\Commerz\Money\Money $budget = null, ?\DateTimeImmutable $startsAt = null, ?\DateTimeImmutable $endsAt = null, \Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Enums\PromotionStatus $status = Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Enums\PromotionStatus::Active);
    static assertBudget(?\Commerz\Money\Money $budget): void;
    static assertName(string $name): void;
    static assertPriority(int $priority): void;
}
```

### PromotionExplanation {#type-commerz-promotions-definitions-data-promotionexplanation}

`Commerz\Promotions\Definitions\Data\PromotionExplanation`

Why the promotions did what they did in a quote: the quote itself (or the failure that stopped it), a verdict for every promotion that was switched on, in the order they were tried, and the rejections of presented codes. Coupon promotions whose code was not presented have no verdict.

```php
}
```

### PromotionActivator {#type-commerz-promotions-rules-contracts-promotionactivator}

`Commerz\Promotions\Rules\Contracts\PromotionActivator`

Decides which promotions of the activator are switched on for a quote: `automatic` always, `coupon` by a presented code. The engine knows neither word; a plugin can bring its own way (a loyalty tier, a referral link).

```php
interface PromotionActivator {
    const KIND = 'promotion_activator';
    // Called once per quote for all the candidates of this activator. May read the database, never writes.
    activate(\Commerz\Promotions\Rules\Data\ActivationRequest $request): \Commerz\Promotions\Rules\Data\ActivationResult;
    // Contribution key, e.g. `automatic`, `coupon` or `acme.referral`.
    key(): string;
}
```

### PromotionCondition {#type-commerz-promotions-rules-contracts-promotioncondition}

`Commerz\Promotions\Rules\Contracts\PromotionCondition`

A condition a promotion needs before its effects apply. Stored by key and `version()`, never by class: a rule whose plugin is gone, or whose parameters cannot be upgraded, makes its promotion `unsupported` and not applied.

```php
interface PromotionCondition {
    const KIND = 'promotion_condition';
    // Does not write and makes no network call; time comes from the quote context.
    evaluate(\Commerz\Promotions\Rules\Data\ConditionInput $input): \Commerz\Promotions\Rules\Data\ConditionOutcome;
    // Contribution key, e.g. `cart.subtotal_at_least` or `acme.vip_only`.
    key(): string;
    // Validates the parameters and returns them in canonical form.
    normalize(\Commerz\Promotions\Rules\Data\RuleParams $params, \Commerz\Promotions\Rules\Data\RuleScope $scope): \Commerz\Promotions\Rules\Data\RuleParams;
    role(): \Commerz\Promotions\Rules\Enums\ConditionRole;
    stages(): array;
    // Brings parameters stored at an older version to the current one.
    upgrade(\Commerz\Promotions\Rules\Data\RuleParams $params, int $fromVersion): \Commerz\Promotions\Rules\Data\RuleParams;
    // The current version of the parameter schema, at least 1.
    version(): int;
}
```

### PromotionEffect {#type-commerz-promotions-rules-contracts-promotioneffect}

`Commerz\Promotions\Rules\Contracts\PromotionEffect`

What a promotion takes off. The engine checks every discount (a known line, the quote currency, never above the remaining price) and applies a promotion whole or not at all.

```php
interface PromotionEffect {
    const KIND = 'promotion_effect';
    // Does not write and makes no network call; time comes from the quote context.
    apply(\Commerz\Promotions\Rules\Data\EffectInput $input): array;
    // Contribution key, e.g. `order.percent_off` or `acme.cashback_cap`.
    key(): string;
    // Validates the parameters and returns them in canonical form.
    normalize(\Commerz\Promotions\Rules\Data\RuleParams $params, \Commerz\Promotions\Rules\Data\RuleScope $scope): \Commerz\Promotions\Rules\Data\RuleParams;
    stages(): array;
    // Brings parameters stored at an older version to the current one.
    upgrade(\Commerz\Promotions\Rules\Data\RuleParams $params, int $fromVersion): \Commerz\Promotions\Rules\Data\RuleParams;
    // The current version of the parameter schema, at least 1.
    version(): int;
}
```

### RuleParams {#type-commerz-promotions-rules-data-ruleparams}

`Commerz\Promotions\Rules\Data\RuleParams`

The parameters of a rule as a canonical JSON-safe map: keys sorted, `Money` as `{amount_minor, currency}`, enums as their value, dates as ISO-8601 UTC. No floats and no other objects, so what is stored is what was meant and two equal configurations are equal byte for byte.

```php
final readonly class RuleParams {
    choice(string $key, array $allowed, ?string $default = null): string;
    // The currencies of all the `Money` values inside, sorted and without repeats: what a promotion without its own currency would have to take from its rules.
    currencies(): array;
    static fromInput(array $input): self;
    int(string $key, int $min = \PHP_INT_MIN, int $max = \PHP_INT_MAX): int;
    money(string $key, \Commerz\Money\Currency $currency): \Commerz\Money\Money;
    nullableInt(string $key, int $min = \PHP_INT_MIN, int $max = \PHP_INT_MAX): ?int;
    // Refuses a parameter that is not in the list, so a typo does not pass as a rule that does nothing.
    only(array $keys): self;
    string(string $key, ?string $pattern = null): string;
    stringList(string $key, int $min, int $max, ?string $pattern = null): array;
    toArray(): array;
}
```

### PromotionUnavailable {#type-commerz-promotions-usage-exceptions-promotionunavailable}

`Commerz\Promotions\Usage\Exceptions\PromotionUnavailable`

A promotion the quote applied can no longer be used when the order is placed: `$reason` is `promotion_not_found`, `promotion_not_active`, `coupon_not_found` or `coupon_disabled`. The placement rolls back; quote again.

```php

    const COUPON_DISABLED = 'coupon_disabled';
    const COUPON_NOT_FOUND = 'coupon_not_found';
    const PROMOTION_NOT_ACTIVE = 'promotion_not_active';
    const PROMOTION_NOT_FOUND = 'promotion_not_found';
    public readonly ?string $couponCode;
    public readonly string $promotionId;
    public readonly string $reason;
    __construct(string $promotionId, ?string $couponCode, string $reason);
    category(): \Commerz\Errors\ErrorCategory;
    code(): string;
    context(): array;
}
```
